lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a grid-like configuration posterior to the gill region, exhibiting distinct spatial periodicity along the lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal spot rows to form a checkerboard-like matrix of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A pronounced longitudinal feature along the upper third of the flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, transitioning from light values above to shadow-cast pixels below.

other_distinctive_markers: Cluster of multiple small, high-chroma yellow objects localized around the rostral margin and oral cleft.
